headline: A 2018 law officially names an unnamed mountain in California's John Muir Wilderness "Sky Point."
what_it_does: This law gives an official name, Sky Point, to a specific mountain inside the John Muir Wilderness, which is part of the Sierra National Forest in California. It is a naming measure only. The summary does not describe any new rules, funding, or changes to how the land is managed.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on January 10, 2018.
